Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL1909294. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to include canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1909294. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID. Do not deduplicate.
